sentences.en: You know, it's both exciting and something that, you know, makes me a little nervous.

sentences.zh: 我想无论什么时候换新工作，即使是非常令人兴奋的工作，你也总是会紧张，对吧？

sentences.zh: 你必须让自己面对挑战，面对那些你可能不知道所有答案、面对与你过去习惯的

sentences.en: be in.

sentences.en: And so like, that's part of the appeal to me is like, oh, I'm going to go do this thing where not only am I going to be working in a different job, I'm going to be working
sentences.zh: 所以，这对我来说吸引力的一部分就在于，哦，我要去做这件事，不仅要在不同的工作中工作，还要在

sentences.en: So I'm excited.
sentences.zh: 所以我很兴奋。

sentences.en: I'm excited.
sentences.zh: 我很兴奋。

sentences.en: And I am also nervous.

sentences.en: Like, how am I going to, how am I going to deal with that?

sentences.en: You know?

sentences.en: And I think I will adapt.

sentences.en: I mean, I'm excited too.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我也很兴奋。

sentences.en: Like, cause I get to like vicariously live through you, you know?
sentences.zh: 因为我可以像感同身受一样体验你的经历，你知道吗？

sentences.zh: 也就是说，每个人无论对自己的公司感觉如何，总是会想，你知道的，外面的草是不是更绿，诸如此类。

sentences.zh: 别误会我的意思。

sentences.en: I love working for NVIDIA.

sentences.en: It's one of the best companies in the world.
sentences.zh: 这是世界上最好的公司之一。

sentences.zh: 外部公司做调查时，它总是被评为极佳的工作场所。

sentences.en: I don't think it's one of the beSt.
sentences.zh: 我不认为它是“之一”。

sentences.en: I think it's the best company in the world.
sentences.zh: 我认为它是世界上最好的公司。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Well, you know, I, the people are going to say we're biased cause we work here, but
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道，人们会说我们有偏见，因为我们在这里工作，但是

sentences.zh: 至于我的具体工作范围，我觉得我们现在还没有答案。

sentences.en: Probably, you know, given my background, probably going to be working on the, you know, an inference side of things on optimization, on CUDA stuff.
sentences.zh: 可能，考虑到我的背景，大概会从事推理方面的工作，比如优化、CUDA相关的工作。

sentences.en: But there's actually, I think one of the nice things about modal, one of the things that's
sentences.zh: 不过实际上，我觉得Modal的其中一个好处，或者说它最吸引我的地方在于

sentences.en: so attractive to me about modal is there's so many parts of the product that I could imagine contributing to.
sentences.zh: 它的产品中有许多部分我都想象自己能参与其中并做出贡献。

sentences.en: You know, the, there's the, the inference part of modal's business where I think I could contribute.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，Modal的业务里有推理这一块，我觉得自己可以在这里贡献力量。

sentences.en: There's the, you know, GPU as a platform, GPU sandbox is part of the product.
sentences.zh: 还有，GPU作为一个平台，GPU沙盒也是产品的一部分。

sentences.en: And then there's the agentic part of the product, all of which are things that I, I've spent a lot of time working on these things.
sentences.zh: 接着是产品的智能体部分，这些都是我花大量时间研究过的内容。

sentences.en: And I have a lot of thoughts about like how we could build the platform of the future for this agentic era.
sentences.zh: 而且对于如何为这个智能体时代构建未来的平台，我有很多想法。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's very exciting.
sentences.zh: 是的，这非常令人兴奋。

sentences.en: I mean, I'm walking back a little bit of our having guests on all the time now, because I feel like we're going to have to reserve a certain cadence of you just telling us,
sentences.zh: 我是说，我现在开始稍微减少邀请嘉宾上节目的频率了，因为我觉得我们得留出一定的节奏，让你来

sentences.en: like taking us along the startup journey.
sentences.zh: 带我们一同经历这段创业之旅。

sentences.en: Well, I mean, my question is, how are you feeling?
sentences.zh: 好吧，我的问题是，你现在感觉怎么样？

sentences.en: I'm feeling good.
sentences.zh: 我感觉很好。

sentences.en: You know, I just had a chat with my boss at NVIDIA and he was sad to see me go, but you know, supportive.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我刚刚和我在英伟达的老板聊过，他虽然对我的离开感到难过，但也表示支持。

sentences.en: And that's one of the beautiful things about NVIDIA.
sentences.zh: 这也是英伟达的美妙之处之一。

sentences.en: You said Louise.
sentences.zh: 你刚刚说的是路易斯（Louise）。

sentences.en: Is that the guy that came from Octo?
sentences.zh: 就是那个从Octo来的人吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah.
sentences.zh: 对，对。

sentences.en: He was in this space of like inference providers back in the day.
sentences.zh: 他当年就在推理服务提供商这个领域。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: But no, I mean, he's great.
sentences.zh: 不过说真的，他非常棒。

sentences.en: And he was, he was very supportive.
sentences.zh: 而且他非常支持我。

sentences.en: I feel good.
sentences.zh: 我感觉很好。

sentences.en: You know, it was tough decision to come to.
sentences.zh: 你知道，做出这个决定挺艰难的。

sentences.en: I, when I came to NVIDIA, the job before NVIDIA, I was not happy.
sentences.zh: 我加入英伟达时，在英伟达之前的那份工作让我很不开心。

sentences.en: I, I, I, I didn't feel like appreciated or understood.
sentences.zh: 我、我、我、我感觉自己没有受到赏识或理解。

sentences.en: And the stuff I was working on was not necessarily the things that I, that were like valued by the work.
sentences.zh: 我手头做的事情也未必是那些被工作本身所重视的事情。

sentences.en: And I, I had a manager who I just didn't get, or I had a project lead that I just didn't get like along with well.
sentences.zh: 而且我有一个实在合不来的经理，或者说有一个项目主管，我们俩相处得不太好。

sentences.en: And it was very obvious that it was time for me to leave.
sentences.zh: 很明显，我当时是时候离开了。

sentences.en: And like NVIDIA just like 100% felt like the right place.
sentences.zh: 而英伟达给我的感觉百分之百就是那个正确的地方。

sentences.en: So I didn't have any questions about, you know, the decision at the time.
sentences.zh: 所以当时我对这个决定没有任何疑问。

sentences.en: It was, it was just a question of like, do I, like, where do I go?
sentences.zh: 这纯粹是一个问题，就是“我该去哪儿？”

sentences.en: In this case, it was really different because I'm very happy at NVIDIA.
sentences.zh: 但这次情况完全不同，因为我在英伟达过得很开心。

sentences.en: And so it wasn't just a question of like picking between options.
sentences.zh: 所以这不单单是在几个选项之间做选择。

sentences.en: There weren't really options.
sentences.zh: 其实并没有什么别的选项。

sentences.en: It was just like this one, you know, do I go to this new company, take this very unique
sentences.zh: 这只是类似于：我是去这家新公司，抓住这个非常独特的

sentences.en: opportunity, take a risk, go try a startup for a while, see what that's like, or do I stay
sentences.zh: 机遇，冒个险，去初创公司待上一段时间，看看那是什么感觉，还是留在

sentences.en: at NVIDIA?
sentences.zh: 英伟达？

sentences.en: And, you know, it, I feel like I don't want to spend my entire career working at one company.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我觉得我不想整个职业生涯都在一家公司工作。

sentences.en: As much as I love NVIDIA, I want to have perspective of what other cultures are like.
sentences.zh: 尽管我深爱英伟达，但我还是想见识一下其他公司的文化是什么样的。

sentences.en: And I feel like that, that will help me grow as a person in ways that I never could just being at one company.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这会以我仅待在一家公司时绝对无法企及的方式帮助我个人成长。

sentences.en: So this has not been a thing, it's a thing that I've always sort of wanted to be able to do, to go to a startup, but there's not been a good time in my life to do it before now.
sentences.zh: 所以这不是心血来潮，这是我一直以来都想做的事——去一家初创公司，只是以前一直没有遇到合适的人生时机。

sentences.en: And this is like the perfect time to do it.
sentences.zh: 而现在就是做这件事的绝佳时机。

sentences.en: And so the timing just like happened to be right.
sentences.zh: 所以时机恰到好处。

sentences.en: And then this, you know, incredible opportunity came up and I really believe in the product.
sentences.zh: 接着这个难以置信的机会出现了，而且我真的非常相信他们的产品。

sentences.en: I really believe in the design language of the company.
sentences.zh: 我真的很认同这家公司的设计语言。

sentences.en: And I'll explain that in two ways.
sentences.zh: 我会从两个方面来解释这一点。

sentences.en: That was honestly the thing that sold me on Modal.
sentences.zh: 老实说，正是这一点让我最终决定加入Modal。

sentences.en: If you look at any material that Modal puts out there, there is so much care and thought
sentences.zh: 如果你看任何Modal发布的文件或资料，你会发现他们在呈现方式上投入了极多的精力和心思

sentences.en: into how it is presented that I think is comparable only to two other companies that I deeply respect,
sentences.zh: 我觉得这只有另外两家我深感敬佩的公司能够与之媲美，

sentences.en: which is NVIDIA and Apple, that there's just a lot of thought into the presentation of things.
sentences.zh: 那就是英伟达和苹果，他们在事物的呈现上都倾注了大量的思考。

sentences.en: And fundamentally, I am a factory that spits out slide decks.
sentences.zh: 从根本上讲，我就是个批量生产幻灯片的工厂。

sentences.en: I care a lot about the presentation of things.
sentences.zh: 我非常在意事物的呈现效果。

sentences.en: But like it says something to you about the culture of a company when you can see how much care goes into the way that the company presents itself to the public.
sentences.zh: 但当你看到一家公司在向公众展示自己时倾注了多少心血，这其实向你说明了这家公司的文化。

sentences.en: It speaks to the culture of quality in all things that they do.
sentences.zh: 它彰显了他们做事精益求精的文化。

sentences.en: And I think that's true both on the, you know, the outward facing presentation side of things, but also when you talk to people at Modal about the platform that they've built,
sentences.zh: 我认为这不仅体现在对外展示的层面，而且当你和Modal的人聊起他们构建的平台时，

sentences.en: they've built it as a series of composable building blocks that interoperate with each other.
sentences.zh: 你会发现他们将其构建为一系列可组合、可互操作的模块化积木。

sentences.en: And I think that the, what's the word that I would be looking for here?
sentences.zh: 我觉得……我在这里想找的词是什么来着？

sentences.en: It's maybe about the principled nature.
sentences.zh: 也许是关于他们设计的原则性。

sentences.en: Yeah, the principled nature of their design, I think, is really a competitive advantage.
sentences.zh: 对，他们设计背后的原则性，我认为这真的是一种竞争优势。

sentences.en: I think it's very powerful that they've put a lot of thought into how they build these building blocks and how things connect with each other and build on top of each other
sentences.zh: 我觉得非常厉害的是，他们在如何构建这些积木、如何让事物相互连接并在彼此之上构建，

sentences.en: and how the platform composes.
sentences.zh: 以及平台如何组合方面，倾注了大量的思考。

sentences.en: And, you know, as a programming language person, as a library design person, that deeply resonates with me, right?
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，作为一个编程语言出身、库设计出身的人，这深深地触动了我，对吧？

sentences.en: And that's really the thing that makes me want to go there is I just think it's a really good platform.
sentences.zh: 这才是真正让我想要去那里的原因，因为我真的觉得这是一个非常棒的平台。

sentences.en: I saw this talk at Ghost in Paris where there was this fellow from, what's the company that makes Minix?
sentences.zh: 我在巴黎的Gopher大会上看过一个演讲，演讲者来自……制作Minix的那家公司叫什么来着？

sentences.en: Minimax, it's one of the Chinese labs.
sentences.zh: Minimax，是中国的一家实验室。

sentences.en: And he was giving a talk about the latest Minimax model.
sentences.zh: 他当时在做关于最新Minimax模型的演讲。

sentences.en: And one of the things he said is, one of the things I love about working here is, I have unlimited tokens.
sentences.zh: 他说的一句话我印象很深，他说：“我在这里工作最喜欢的一点就是，我有无限的代币（tokens）。”

sentences.en: I have all the tokens that I could possibly want.
sentences.zh: “我有我想要多少就能有多少的代币。”

sentences.en: And my girlfriend uses the tokens and I use the tokens for all the things I never have to worry about it.
sentences.zh: “我女朋友用代币，我做所有事情也都用代币，我根本不用担心。”

sentences.en: And I was like, you know, that's actually like a very interesting, it's a very interesting like perspective.
sentences.zh: 当时我就想，你知道的，这其实是一个非常有趣、非常有趣的视角。

sentences.en: And, you know, like there's something nice about like being at a place that produces the product that you would want to use all the time, because then like you get to dog food
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，身处一个能生产出你会经常想用的产品的公司，这是一件很棒的事，因为这样你就能进行更多

sentences.en: a lot more.
sentences.zh: 的内部真实试用（dog food）。

sentences.en: And like modal is a product that in my like day-to-day work on CUDA, like almost every day, my life would be easier if I could just use modal for everything.
sentences.zh: 像Modal这样的产品，在我日常从事CUDA工作的过程中，几乎每天如果能直接用Modal处理一切，我的生活都会变得更轻松。

sentences.en: And now I will just be able to use modal for everything.
sentences.zh: 现在我终于可以真的用Modal处理一切了。

sentences.en: So it's great.
sentences.zh: 所以这太棒了。

sentences.en: Like I'm sure like one of the first thing I'll do when I'm getting sitting up there is I will set up all of the agentic stuff that I do, both personal and professional, like
sentences.zh: 我敢肯定，我到那里安顿下来后做的第一件事，就是把我的所有智能体相关工作——无论是个人还是工作上的——

sentences.en: on modal's ecosystem.
sentences.zh: 全都设置在Modal的生态系统上。

sentences.en: And it will solve all of the current challenges that I have with my like agentic workflows.
sentences.zh: 它将解决我目前在智能体工作流中遇到的所有挑战。

sentences.en: I, the, the amount that I spend in tokens at NVIDIA is, you know, far higher than what I would
sentences.zh: 我在英伟达花在代币上的费用，你知道的，要远远高于

sentences.en: use on modal for just like raw compute, right?
sentences.zh: 我在Modal上仅用于纯计算的消耗，对吧？

sentences.en: If I was, but, you know, NVIDIA has its own internal inference, you know, ecosystem, its own internal access to compute, et cetera.
sentences.zh: 如果我是……不过，你知道，英伟达有它自己的内部推理生态系统，有它内部的计算资源访问权限等等。

sentences.en: And if I like, that's the thing that I have to use if I want to go down the easy path.
sentences.zh: 如果我想走轻松的路线，那就是我必须使用的东西。

sentences.en: And if I wanted to use some external vendor, I'd have to go get approval for that.
sentences.zh: 如果我想用某个外部供应商的服务，我还得去申请审批。

sentences.en: And so there's a nice thing about like, if you're at the company, like you don't have to go and get approval to you to like use your own thing, right?
sentences.zh: 所以这就有一个好处，如果你在公司内部，你就不需要去申请审批来使用你自己的东西，对吧？

sentences.en: Like there's sure there's some limit, but I'm sure that whatever the limit is, we'll be fine.
sentences.zh: 虽说肯定会有一些限制，但我确信无论限制是什么，我们都能应付。

sentences.en: That's very nice.
sentences.zh: 这真的很棒。

sentences.en: What did, uh, what did everybody say?
sentences.zh: 大家……大家都说了些什么？

sentences.en: Um, and my manager was, I think, saddened to see me leave that he was really enjoying working with me.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我的经理，我觉得他对我离开感到有点难过，因为他真的很享受和我共事的时光。

sentences.en: And honestly, I've really enjoyed working with him.
sentences.zh: 老实说，我也非常享受和他一起工作的日子。

sentences.en: And that is one of the things that makes me saddest about leaving NVIDIA is, uh, I wish we'd had more time to work together, but, uh, everybody was supportive.
sentences.zh: 这也是离开英伟达最让我难过的事情之一，我希望我们能有更多时间一起共事，不过，大家都给予了支持。

sentences.en: That's one of the great things about NVIDIA is I think when people do decide to leave NVIDIA,
sentences.zh: 这也是英伟达伟大的地方之一，我认为当人们决定离开英伟达时，

sentences.en: we're very supportive of the growth of people who work at NVIDIA, you know, we're like, sometimes the, the right move for somebody is to go somewhere else.
sentences.zh: 我们非常支持在英伟达工作的人们的成长，你知道的，有时候对某个人来说正确的选择就是去别的地方。

sentences.en: And I think that the company is very good about, you know, if, obviously if it's, you
sentences.zh: 而且我觉得公司在这方面做得很好，当然，如果可以的话，

sentences.en: know, we would prefer people stay, if there's something that we can do, if somebody is unhappy, if there's some problem, you know, we try to find a way to fix it.
sentences.zh: 我们更希望人们留下来。如果有什么我们可以做的，如果有人不开心，如果有什么问题，你知道的，我们会努力寻找解决的办法。

sentences.en: But if it's just that somebody is like, I've made this decision, you know, I think I want to go, I think we're pretty good about being supportive about that and celebrating the,
sentences.zh: 但如果只是某个人下定决心说“我已经决定了，我想走”，我觉得我们在给予支持以及庆祝

sentences.en: the growth of people, even as they depart NVIDIA, you know, there's like, there's like a question whenever you're like, you know, mentoring or advising someone, there's like
sentences.zh: 人们的成长方面做得相当不错，即使他们在离开英伟达时也是如此。你知道，每当你指导或建议某人时，总会面临

sentences.en: two questions.
sentences.zh: 两个问题。

sentences.en: There's like, what's the best thing to help this person personally grow?
sentences.zh: 一个是，怎样做对这个人的个人成长最好？

sentences.en: And what's the thing that, you know, helps the company the most?
sentences.zh: 另一个是，怎样做对公司最有利？

sentences.en: And I think NVIDIA does a really good job of striking a good balance there.
sentences.zh: 我觉得英伟达在平衡这两者方面做得非常出色。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Not a lot of companies do that, to be honeSt.
sentences.zh: 老实说，没多少公司能做到这一点。

sentences.en: Although probably the bigger the company, the better in general.
sentences.zh: 不过可能公司越大，在这方面总体来说就越好。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: That's awesome, man.
sentences.zh: 这太棒了，老兄。

sentences.en: How's Ramona feel about it?
sentences.zh: 雷莫娜（Ramona）对此怎么看？

sentences.en: Excited?
sentences.zh: 很兴奋？

sentences.en: Worried?
sentences.zh: 还是担心？

sentences.en: I think Ramona is glad that she no longer has to have me incessantly asking her for her opinion and showing her slide decks that I made on the topic.
sentences.zh: 我觉得雷莫娜很高兴她终于不用再忍受我没完没了地征求她的意见，也无需再看我为此制作的幻灯片了。

sentences.en: I did make slide decks on this.
sentences.zh: 我确实为此做了幻灯片。

sentences.en: Is she the only one that saw them?
sentences.zh: 她是唯一看到这些幻灯片的人吗？

sentences.en: No, my mother also, my mother also saw the slide decks.
sentences.zh: 不，我妈妈也看过了，我妈妈也看过那些幻灯片。

sentences.en: What was it?
sentences.zh: 那是什么？

sentences.en: Like a big life change soliciting feedback or what?
sentences.zh: 就像是为了人生重大转变而征求反馈，还是怎么回事？

sentences.en: Is it more for yourself?
sentences.zh: 这更多是为了你自己吗？

sentences.en: Like you giving a presentation helps you?
sentences.zh: 比如做个演讲对你更有帮助？

sentences.en: It was more for myself, I think.
sentences.zh: 我想更多是为了我自己吧。

sentences.en: I think it was more for myself.
sentences.zh: 我觉得更多是为了我自己。

sentences.en: But it was also to like help understand, like there's sometimes some things that just like making a chart and like, you know, a table or something, presenting it in a nice way
sentences.zh: 但这也是为了帮助理清思路，有时候有些事情，只要做个图表、表格什么的，以一种漂亮的方式呈现出来，

sentences.en: is like the easiest way to express the information to people to get their input, which I did.
sentences.zh: 就是向大家表达信息并征求他们意见的最简单方法，我也确实这么做了。

sentences.en: And I think I, I think it helped.
sentences.zh: 而且我觉得，我觉得这很有帮助。

sentences.en: I got sort of the, the, one of the questions that both my mother and Ramona asked me without realizing that the other person had asked it is, would you take pride in representing
sentences.zh: 我得到了一个问题，我妈妈和雷莫娜在彼此不知情的情况下都问了我同一个问题，那就是：你会以为代表

sentences.en: this new company?
sentences.zh: 这家新公司而感到自豪吗？

sentences.en: Like, would you, would you wear, should they, my mom specifically asked me like, you know, if you go to this new company, if you go to modal and you, you go to a conference and
sentences.zh: 就像是，你会不会……我妈特意问我，你知道的，如果你去了这家新公司，如果你去了Modal，你去参加一个会议，

sentences.en: you're wearing a modal t-shirt, would you be proud of that?
sentences.zh: 穿着一件Modal的T恤，你会为此感到骄傲吗？

sentences.en: And my answer is yeah.
sentences.zh: 我的回答是，会的。

sentences.en: And, and it strikes me that when I first went to NVIDIA for my like pre-interview with Chris
sentences.zh: 而且我突然想起，当年我第一次去英伟达参加克里斯·兰姆（Chris Lamb）的

sentences.en: Lamb, I had lunch with Olivier afterwards.
sentences.zh: 预面试时，之后我和奥利维耶（Olivier）一起吃了个午饭。

sentences.en: And I noticed that a large chunk of the employees, and this was in 2017, a large chunk of the employees on just some random Tuesday or whatever were wearing NVIDIA t-shirts around
sentences.zh: 我注意到很大一部分员工——那是2017年——很大一部分员工在某个普通的周二或其他日子里，

sentences.en: the office.
sentences.zh: 都在办公室里穿着英伟达的T恤。

sentences.en: It was almost like a uniform and nobody, nobody required that, you know, it was just a choice that people made.
sentences.zh: 这几乎就像是制服一样，而且没有人强制要求，你知道的，这纯粹是大家自发的选择。

sentences.en: And, um, you know, NVIDIA never, we didn't have free lunch at NVIDIA, right?
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，英伟达从不……我们在英伟达没有免费午餐，对吧？

sentences.en: We didn't have candy bars.
sentences.zh: 我们没有糖果巧克力。

sentences.en: We didn't have snack bars, you know, people were there because they believed in the mission
sentences.zh: 我们没有小吃吧，你知道的，大家来这里是因为他们相信使命

sentences.en: and they believed in the company and the company took care of people and people were proud to work there and were proud of the product.
sentences.zh: 并且相信公司，公司也照顾员工，员工为在这里工作感到自豪，也为产品感到自豪。

sentences.en: And, uh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 嗯，对。

sentences.en: And my, both my girlfriend and my mother recognized that I take a lot of pride in where I work and in the prestige that comes with where I work.
sentences.zh: 而且，我的女朋友和母亲都意识到，我非常为自己工作的地方以及伴随而来的声誉感到自豪。

sentences.en: And they both like wanted, wanted to know, would I feel the same prestige going to modal?
sentences.zh: 她们俩都想知道，我去Modal会不会也有同样的自豪感？

sentences.en: And the answer was yes.
sentences.zh: 我的回答是肯定的。

sentences.en: But, you know, when I first started working at NVIDIA, nobody had heard of NVIDIA, you know, that did not change the level of pride that I felt in the work that I was doing,
sentences.zh: 不过，你知道，当我刚开始在英伟达工作时，没人听说过英伟达，但这并没有改变我对所做工作的自豪感，

sentences.en: that I felt it was a unique company building a unique product that I could not really go anywhere else to do.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这是一家独一无二的公司，正在打造一款独一无二的产品，我去别的地方是绝对做不出来的。

sentences.en: And I feel the same way about modal, that I think they have a unique set of technologies
sentences.zh: 我对Modal也有同样的看法，我认为他们拥有一套独特的技术，

sentences.en: and I don't think there's anywhere else I could go to do the things that I'm going to
sentences.zh: 而且我觉得我去其他任何地方都无法做成我将在那里

sentences.en: do there.
sentences.zh: 做的事情。

sentences.en: And Ramona was asking, like, you know, if you go to a conference and people don't know, you know, the name of the company that you're working at, like, how are you going to feel?
sentences.zh: 雷莫娜还问过，你知道的，如果你去参加一个会议，而人们并不知道你工作的公司名字，你会作何感想？

sentences.en: And I was like, that actually could be relieving.
sentences.zh: 当时我说，这其实挺让人放松的。

sentences.en: I mean, I go to so many conferences and people are always, you know, I say that I'm at NVIDIA and people ooh and ah or ask about a job and it'll kind of be nice to be a little more
sentences.zh: 我是说，我参加过那么多会议，人们总是，你知道的，当我说是英伟达的，大家就会惊叹或者打听工作机会，所以能稍微低调匿名一点其实也挺好的。

sentences.en: anonymous.
sentences.zh: 匿名一点。

sentences.en: How was the interview process?
sentences.zh: 面试过程怎么样？

sentences.en: Was it?
sentences.zh: 是怎样的？

sentences.en: I gave, it was like a, it was a research presentation.
sentences.zh: 我做了一个，就像是一个研究报告演讲。

sentences.en: So you give a, instead of like technical questions, you just give a talk.
sentences.zh: 所以你不是出技术问题，而是做一个演讲。

sentences.en: I gave my talk, my auto research talk, the Insight Factory talk, which will be my last talk at NVIDIA that I will give the week that I'm in HQ.
sentences.zh: 我做了我的演讲，我的汽车研究演讲，即“洞察工厂”演讲，这将是我在NVIDIA总部的那个星期里发表的最后一次演讲。

sentences.en: When's that, October I assume?
sentences.zh: 那是什么时候，我猜是十月？

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah, October.
sentences.zh: 对，对，十月。

sentences.en: So I'm going to PyCon Taipei to, in a very Bryce style.
sentences.zh: 所以我要去台北的PyCon，用非常Bryce的风格。

sentences.en: My last week at NVIDIA, I will be traveling.
sentences.zh: 我在NVIDIA的最后一周，我会在出差中度过。

sentences.en: So I'm going to PyCon Taipei.
sentences.zh: 所以我要去台北的PyCon。

sentences.en: I'm visiting you on the way to PyCon Taipei.
sentences.zh: 我会在去台北PyCon的路上顺便拜访你。

sentences.en: So I'm going New York, New York to Toronto, staying there for the day.
sentences.zh: 所以我从纽约出发，纽约到多伦多，在那里呆一天。

sentences.en: Toronto to Hong Kong, Hong Kong to Taipei.
sentences.zh: 多伦多到香港，香港到台北。

sentences.en: And then I go Taipei to Vancouver, stay there for the night.
sentences.zh: 然后我从台北到温哥华，在那里过夜。

sentences.en: Vancouver to SFO.
sentences.zh: 温哥华到旧金山湾区。

sentences.en: And, and then...
sentences.zh: 然后，然后...

sentences.en: Wait, wait, say this again.
sentences.zh: 等等，等等，再说一遍。

sentences.en: You go from, what's your flight schedule?
sentences.zh: 你从，你的航班行程是什么？

sentences.en: You're going to Vancouver from Toronto or that's on the way back from Taipei?
sentences.zh: 你是从多伦多去温哥华，还是那是从台北回来的路上？

sentences.en: That's from Taiwan.
sentences.zh: 那是从台湾出发。

sentences.en: Taiwan to Vancouver, Vancouver to Silicon Valley.
sentences.zh: 台湾到温哥华，温哥华到硅谷。

sentences.en: And then I'm going to be there for the week for the kernels, for the fast kernels, face-to-face.
sentences.zh: 然后我将在那里待上一周，为了内核，为了快速内核的面对面会议。

sentences.en: And then, and then from there, I will, like, that'll be my last week.
sentences.zh: 然后，从那里开始，我将，比如，那将是我的最后一周。

sentences.en: And then I'll go home and I might, my, my final day at NVIDIA may be a Monday, just so I have a little time to, like, do, like, my final expense report.
sentences.zh: 然后我会回家，我可能会，我的，我在NVIDIA的最后一天可能是一个星期一，这样我就可以有一点时间来，比如，做，比如，我的最终费用报销。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And then I'm going to take a week to organize the house and I'll start at modal, like, November 2nd.
sentences.zh: 然后我要花一周时间整理房子，我将在11月2日左右加入Modal。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And they, they, um, so I'm going to start there.
sentences.zh: 他们，他们，嗯，所以我要去那里开始工作。

sentences.en: I'm reporting into the CTO, um, and co-founder and, um, I'm going to take...
sentences.zh: 我向CTO汇报，嗯，还有联合创始人，嗯，我要...

sentences.en: Is that someone I know or...
sentences.zh: 那是我的熟人还是...

sentences.en: I don't think so.
sentences.zh: 我想不是。

sentences.en: And, um, then I'm going to figure out, you know, where I can be useful.
sentences.zh: 然后，嗯，接下来我要弄清楚，你知道的，我在哪里能发挥作用。

sentences.en: But yeah, I'm really excited about the, like, leadership and mentorship opportunities there.
sentences.zh: 不过说实话，我对那里的领导力和指导机会真的很兴奋。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: I mean, you've always been doing that, you know, at every stage in your career, so...
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你在职业生涯的每个阶段一直都在这样做，所以...

sentences.en: It's also, like, it's fun to go to a company.
sentences.zh: 这也是，比如，去一家公司很有趣。

sentences.en: Like, one of the appeals of going to a startup to me is the employee count at NVIDIA is not going to double, you know, in a year.
sentences.zh: 比如，去一家初创公司吸引我的地方之一在于，NVIDIA的员工人数在一年内是不会翻倍的。

sentences.en: The employee count at a startup like modal, it might double in a year and then it might double again.
sentences.zh: 像Modal这样初创公司的员工人数，可能在一年内翻倍，然后可能再次翻倍。

sentences.en: And, like, there's something fun about being at a company early, getting to, like, establish the culture and get to influence the shape and the direction and, like, see it grow so
sentences.zh: 而且，在早期加入一家公司，有机会建立企业文化，有机会影响公司外形和方向，并且看着它这样

sentences.en: rapidly like that.
sentences.zh: 迅速成长，这很有趣。

sentences.en: Like, I think that's going to be a lot of fun.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这会非常有趣。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好吧。
